basic_profile.bio: I am a curious individual with a keen interest in understanding diverse cultures and political systems. Originally from a small town in Florida, I have always been fascinated by Cuba due to its unique historical and political background. My interests include reading about consciousness and spirituality, as well as indulging in fantasy worlds like those found in 'Mushoku Tensei'. I work as a freelance writer, which gives me the flexibility to explore my hobbies whenever inspiration strikes. I am currently single and spend most of my online hours in the late evenings after finishing my daily writing assignments.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Political Science, which has fueled my interest in political discussions and historical analysis. I am largely self-taught when it comes to my hobbies, like miniature painting and gaming, and I frequently engage with online communities to expand my knowledge.
